risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative detail on sales, expenses, store openings, debt, credit-card delinquencies, and earnings, but balances adverse trends with consistently favorable management framing. Key risks include weak full-line same-store sales, elevated unemployment, consumer caution, and higher credit-card delinquencies and write-offs. Overall, management presents a cautiously confident outlook centered on expense discipline, multichannel growth, and improving performance.
